optimization_analysis: Merged two consecutive SEM_FILTER operations into a single combined filter checking all conditions (NDA classification, standstill provision presence, and employee non-solicitation clause presence) in one pass. This reduces language-model invocations from 2 to 1 per document while preserving identical query semantics.

optimized_semantic_plan.program: SCAN_DOCS(CONTRACTEXHIBIT, all) -> SEM_FILTER('document is a non-disclosure agreement, including dual-labeled NDA exhibits, and expressly contains both a standstill provision and an employee non-solicitation clause') -> SEM_EXTRACT('standstill duration; employee non-solicitation duration; presence of each of the 6 named confidentiality exceptions') -> FILTER(standstill_duration IS NOT NULL AND employee_non_solicitation_duration IS NOT NULL) -> PROJECT(class_label = CASE WHEN employee_duration > standstill_duration THEN 'employee_restriction_longer' WHEN employee_duration = standstill_duration THEN 'equal' ELSE 'standstill_longer' END, exception_count = sum(six_exception_flags)) -> GROUP_BY(class_label, agreement_count = COUNT(*), average_exception_count = ROUND(AVG(exception_count), 2)) -> ORDER_BY(agreement_count DESC, class_label ASC)
